verdicts.reason: A has no headline, 'HO SMART' wordmark or URL at all. The white device logo is clipped by the bottom edge of the blue band and half of it sits on white. The photo floats in a large empty white middle, and the diagonal stripes sit on top of the hand. B is worse: it also has no text, the blue parallelogram floats empty, the photo has shrunk to a tiny sliver, and the white logo sits on white, off-axis and practically invisible. A at least keeps the brand blue and the main photo at a size you can see.
